basic_info.description: No lottery First Come First Serve! Spacious 1 bedroom with amazing views! Temporary SFMOHCD Waviers including income limits and first time home buyer status may apply to the following: Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $125,900; 2 = $143,900; 3 = $161,800, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible (See Temporary Waivers for exceptions). Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit is listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org). Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info.Fair Housing Opportunity.
